bias: NFP decides it — no reason to predict, be prepared to react. ES closed right at 7726 inside this week's value: a good reaction lifts it to the 7780s, a bad one that sticks rejects the range and closes the week as a double distribution down. NQ is still in its RTH range; the Asia ATH 'means very little' without a cash-session break. Don't assume every dip gets bought like today's.
wildcard: NFP premarket. 8/31 analog: nearly identical setup (value gapping lower, spike up into close) → 9/1 gapped down and went, then rallied into the close for a swing low. Difference: on 8/31 ES hadn't reclaimed the prior balance. 'Asia gonna Asia' — last night never bid 7749-52 from above, it squeezed through and nuked back. The KOSPI-close reversal (30-60 min before) has worked a ton in both directions.

brief.happened: Every trade on both sides: overnight long off 7718-25 (the liquidation retrace he expected), liquidation-break short back below 7749-52, LBAF long at the overnight low, premarket short at 49-52 offered from below (KOSPI-close reversal), join-short below 7706-09, and the safest long — a LBAF of the IB low 7682.25, aligned with a key SPX area. New low of week 7672.75 took out the 9/18 low. Then he'd written sellers must NOT return above 7718-25 — so it closed RIGHT at 7726 (lol). Value nearly gapped lower vs. overnight, which had gapped lower vs. Wednesday's cash — yet it spiked UP into the close.
brief.pivot: 7718-7725 is the obvious hold for bulls — 'don't be surprised if it isn't that easy.' 7706-7709 is the bare-minimum reclaim. 7749-7752 sits just above today's high and is the key level above.
brief.higher: Firm base above 7749-52 → 7780s, with caution on a first pass into the 60s. Last night squeezed through 49-52 and nuked back; a proper bid from above is what's missing. Today's high 7741.25 taken with continuation is part of the bull case.
brief.lower: 7706-09 holds → bulls 'okay' as long as 18-25 is reclaimed and today's high is taken with continuation. Below 7706-09 risks today's low and new lows — but there's demand in and just below 7696-99 (and the 82-86 range) that could react on first touch and trigger a reclaim. Persistent weakness below 7706-09 → today's low → very likely new lows.

A lower edge is forming at 500-530 (relative equal lows 504.5 / 529.25); upper edges 860-870 (870 Sunday open as proxy) and 951-969. New daily 705-734 separates today's upper and lower distributions.
brief.pivot: 30705-30734 (new) is tonight's line. 638-669 below it; 827-846 above. Lower edge 500-530, upper edges 860-870 and 951-969.
brief.higher: 705-734 holds (LBAF ok) → 827-846, potentially today's high. Beware a failed break of the minor upper edge: a LAAF of today's high that fails back below 827-846 has bigger-picture potential for 500-530. The lower edge 500-530 is on LBAF watch — maybe 469-493 finally trades and triggers it; such a LBAF has bigger-picture potential for 827-846 up to the 870s.
